title: One API call, end to end
lede: The page asks this app; this app adds the key/secret headers and calls the console; the answer comes back with the timing. Simulated in Mock.

nodes.label: Your browser
sub: Search, pick an operation, press Call.

nodes.label: This app (server)
sub: Holds the API secret (write-only), fills the tenant, writes the audit.

nodes.label: In-process mock console
sub: Mock mode. Loopback only, sample data, labelled.

steps.title: You search and press Call
steps.what: Type "pi" to see pi*, filter by tag or method, pick one of the 447 operations, press Call.

steps.title: This app builds the request
steps.what: Path and query parameters are filled from the connection (the tenant) and the form. Nothing user-typed reaches the console unsanitised.

steps.title: The credential is attached
steps.what: Mock: the in-process console on loopback answers from the sample tenant. Real: x-api-key, x-api-secret and a fresh x-procyon-session-id per call.

steps.title: The console answers
steps.what: Status, body and elapsed ms come back through this app. A 401/403 is surfaced as a login refusal.

steps.title: Result and audit
steps.what: The page shows the raw response; the audit keeps the call (redacted, never the secret).
